title: Pin --hostname github.com on the remaining publication-path reads (check-breaking-bump, publish-release, github-release)
description: The QCLI-396 review (2026-10-11, opum-ai/quest-cli#579) found that the hostname pin QCLI-396 added covers only the two reads QCLI-396 named; other publication-path reads remain GH_HOST-sensitive. Confirmed by the quest-cli worker: scripts/check-breaking-bump.mjs readLoreChangelog builds [api, ...args] with no --hostname and reads repos/opum-ai/lore-cli/commits/<ref> and repos/opum-ai/lore-cli/contents/CHANGELOG.md?ref=<sha>; it is the blocking release step at .github/workflows/release.yml:171 (Gate the pair bump level on both CHANGELOGs). Also unpinned: scripts/publish-release.mjs:246-249 (gh api repos/opum-ai/quest-cli/actions/runs/<id>) and :263 (gh run download), and scripts/github-release.mjs:237 (gh release view) and :321 (gh release edit). Whether gh release accepts --hostname is UNVERIFIED. The run read is the load-bearing one: a redirected run read could satisfy qualifyBundle run checks. Decision needed: which of these are in threat scope.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each publication-path read named here is either pinned with --hostname github.com or recorded as deliberately out of threat scope with the reason.
Whether gh release view and gh release edit accept --hostname is measured and recorded before any pin is added to scripts/github-release.mjs.
